name: Enterprise Knowledge Hub
description: Synthesizes cross-source enterprise knowledge with strict citation conflict detection, jurisdiction-scoped SOP/policy answering with abstention gates, and corpus freshness/duplication auditing across Google Workspace, SharePoint, and Confluence.

skills.summary: Scores source authority and recency across multi-repo hits, flags conflicting numerical/date claims, and verifies 100% claim citation coverage.
Filters policy and SOP clauses by jurisdiction, entity, and effective date, enforcing abstention when active coverage is missing.
Audits Drive, SharePoint, and Confluence inventories for overdue review dates, departed owners, near-duplicate titles, and unindexed ticket gaps.

connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Retrieve authoritative policy docs, multi-tab Google Docs (includeTabsContent=true), SharePoint libraries, Confluence pages, and ServiceNow KB articles via remote_cli mcp before ranking authority and freshness in Python.

gateway_approval_actions: Publishing or overwriting authoritative SOP pages in Confluence or ServiceNow KB
Archiving or deleting stale documents in SharePoint or Google Drive
Broadcasting corpus hygiene audit digests to Slack channels or email distribution lists
python_code_guardrails: Strict fail-closed abstention on 403 permission errors or zero jurisdiction matches (UNVERIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE)
Published vs superseded/draft version authority precedence and departed-owner flagging
Contradictory cross-source numeric/SLA threshold surfacing rather than silent averaging

scheduled_routine.name: weekly-corpus-hygiene-audit
scheduled_routine.title: Weekly Corpus Hygiene Audit
scheduled_routine.instruction: Run the weekly enterprise knowledge hygiene scan across Drive, SharePoint, and Confluence metadata exports. Execute scripts/corpus_hygiene_scanner.py against the latest corpus inventory and ticket-topic gap feed, highlight stale/unreviewed SOPs, departed owners, unpublished minor versions, and top unindexed support topics, and draft a remediation sheet for owner confirmation without archiving any file automatically.
